name: circle
description: Select objects within a circular region (2D only). The 2D counterpart of sphere: center gives the centre of the circle and radius its radius.
notes: 2D engines only (FLAC2D 9 enumerates circle and radius; sphere and cylinder are absent there).

FLAC3D 9.8.54 does not accept it: the range phrase ends before 'circle', the command runs on everything the earlier elements selected, and only then 'Unused extra parameter (circle)' is reported. The 3D '?' does list a bare 'radius <f>' element, but 'range radius 1.5' selected no zones on a 2x2x2 brick.
PFC3D 9.8.54 rejects it too, but cleanly: 'Bad conversion of parameter (circle)' before the command runs. Its 'range ?' also lists the bare 'radius <f>', which selected no balls.
official_documentation: Itasca 9.8 shared kernel manual: Range Phrase Keyword Reference
